recap.text: Mongo runs a pack of female dinosaurs to ground, led by a level 60 mongoliensis named Kiwi. Princess Donut charms Kiwi with a potion to use the pack as an escort. Kiwi leads Big Tina, an immortalized city boss, to the party and prevents her from attacking. Mongo and Kiwi bring down Vrah, then Princess Donut uses a potion to turn Kiwi back into Big Tina's mother.

Kiwi remains pregnant since the Hunting Grounds. Big Tina decides Mongo is her father, and nobody in the fortress corrects her. During the Bear Witness event, Colonel Tipid tells Kiwi that Tina is frozen outside the stronghold. Kiwi's water breaks, and Mongo stays by her side so the newborns have his strength. She has two level 0 Legendary Creature daughters with wet brown fur, stubs of wings, and bulbous eyes.

beats.headline: Mongo runs off
beats.text: Mongo bolts with Princess Donut still on his back and runs a pack of dinosaurs to ground. Kiwi is at the head of it. Level 60 mongoliensis, the fastest and cleverest predators anywhere in this jungle, and the whole pack is female, as is every dinosaur anyone has counted in the area. Which is odd. Odder still: dinosaur-class mobs did not exist on this ground before Scolopendra's nine-tier attack, and here they all are. Mongo and Kiwi settle the introductions between themselves, at length, with Princess Donut obliged to watch.
beats.gist: Mongo runs a pack of female dinosaurs to ground with Princess Donut on his back.

beats.headline: White for the cat
beats.text: Kiwi and a few dozen of her pack stand at the edge of the woods outside Point Mongo, looking in. Their dots have turned white for Crawler Princess Donut. Kiwi's is still red for Crawler Carl. Deeper in the trees stands something much bigger that was not there before; it waits, then turns and moves away. Kiwi calls unk, unk, unk once more and the pack melts back into the jungle. Mongo has already stumbled back into town, collapsed in the street with his health full, and gone into his carrier without objection.
beats.gist: Kiwi and her pack stand outside Point Mongo with white dots for Donut and red for Carl.

beats.headline: Tina's mother, by name
beats.text: A barmaid hiding from Big Tina gives the record its missing line. Tina's mother survived the nine-tier attack in the form of a dinosaur, along with several of the other mothers from the night of the recital; they kill too, but they are not as deranged. She still tries to keep Tina from doing too much damage. In the past few nights she has stopped being able to. Her name is Kiwi. Carl informs Mongo of the implications. Princess Donut gasps.
beats.gist: A barmaid tells the record a line about Tina's mother, Kiwi, who is a dinosaur.

beats.headline: Charmed, and an escort
beats.text: Kiwi brings the pack in and Princess Donut charms her with a potion, and the fastest thing on the floor becomes an escort service. Carl works out at the same time that The Plenty arranged this entire chain of events, and that what it wanted out of the arrangement was its precious Prepotente protected.
beats.gist: Donut charms Kiwi with a potion, turning the pack into an escort service for The Plenty's Prepotente.

beats.headline: She keeps pulling east
beats.text: Minion Kiwi obeys Princess Donut, broadly. On the road southeast she veers the party east every half hour until corrected. Halfway there she lifts her head and howls, and the whole pack of thirty-odd raptors vanishes into the trees, sent to look after Big Tina. Left with three companions, she eats constrictors dropping out of the trees faster than anyone else can move. When the rhinoceros's rider fires at Mongo, she leaps at the litter, bounces off its shield and lands on fire.
beats.gist: Kiwi veers the party east every half hour and sends thirty-odd raptors to look after Big Tina.

beats.headline: She stands in front of a city boss
beats.text: The squad comes back to the crawlers with Big Tina walking in behind it. Big Tina is an immortalized city boss and everyone in the clearing understands exactly what that means for the next few seconds. Kiwi steps in front of her. Tina does not attack. Nobody yet has an explanation for it that they would put in writing.
beats.gist: Kiwi steps in front of Big Tina, an immortalized city boss, and Tina does not attack.

beats.headline: Taken all the way back
beats.text: Mongo and Kiwi bring Vrah down together in the middle of the castle battle, which is a sentence worth reading twice. Then Princess Donut uses the I Take It All Back potion on her, and the mongoliensis is gone. An ursine stands in the wreckage, naked but for paper bubbles, and Big Tina looks across at her and knows her mother's face.
beats.gist: Mongo and Kiwi bring Vrah down during the castle battle.

beats.headline: Still pregnant, and family
beats.text: Kiwi is very pregnant and has been carrying since the Hunting Grounds, which is a long time to be in that condition even by this dungeon's standards. Big Tina, for her part, has decided that Mongo is her father. Nobody in the fortress has the standing, the courage, or frankly the desire to correct her.
beats.gist: Kiwi is pregnant since the Hunting Grounds, and Big Tina decides Mongo is the father.

beats.headline: Where is my daughter
beats.text: Status report during the Bear Witness event, taken from the chat. Subject asked for Tina. Where is Tina? Where is her daughter? Colonel Tipid answered: Tina had got out and was fighting outside the stronghold, and he could see her, and she was frozen. Anyone outside a structure was. Then the witnesses were brought forth, straight up into the air.
beats.gist: Kiwi asks for Tina during the Bear Witness event, but Colonel Tipid says Tina is frozen.

beats.headline: Twins, and legendary
beats.text: Kiwi's water broke while she was arguing about getting Big Tina back into the FUPA. In the medical tent she asks for Mongo, and he is brought to her side; in ursine culture, Edgar says, the father's presence lends the newborn his strength. Two girls. They are not bears and not raptors: four legs, stubs of wings, wet brown fur, Mongo's head, bulbous eyes that do not match. Newborn Ursensus, level 0, Legendary Creature, part raptor, part bear, part Scolopendra magic. Too intelligent to be used as pets.
beats.gist: Kiwi gives birth to two legendary Ursensus twins while arguing about Big Tina and the FUPA.
